title: Neural network supports a six-gene predictor of infliximab failure in ulcerative colitis
summary: Three GEO datasets were analyzed with the RobustRankAggreg algorithm to identify genes differing between infliximab responders and non-responders, and an artificial neural network was used to validate their predictive value. The six genes CDX2, CHP2, HSD11B2, RANK, NOX4 and VDR gave a repeated overall AUC of 0.850 ± 0.103, and 0.759 ± 0.065 in an independent GEO dataset. Immunohistochemistry of colonic biopsies from infliximab-treated patients was also performed, with VDR and RANK reported as significant in the reviewed material. The datasets are public and the biopsy cohort is small.
